topics.name: Tier Review and Reduction
topics.purpose: Define explicit reviewed reduction of Tier when qualifying negative evidence is upheld, including higher-Tier peer participation and complete provenance.

semantics.trigger_rule: Tier review is triggered by explicit qualifying review evidence.
semantics.reviewer_rule: Reviewers are exact identities; higher-Tier peer requirement is explicit where policy requires it.
semantics.evidence_rule: Decision references exact negative/positive evidence and current Tier evaluation.
semantics.automatic_rule: No hidden automatic reduction outside declared review policy.
semantics.history_rule: Previous and new Tier evaluations remain traceable.
semantics.appeal_rule: Appeal/re-review does not erase original decision evidence.

invariants.rule: Identity, portfolio, merit, recommendation, trust and competence states derive only from explicit provenance-bearing evidence; display text, self-authored claims, ranking position or AI inference never become verified evidence by themselves.

Distinct canonical identities maintain independent evidence histories; merit, Tier, trust and recommendation histories are not mergeable across identities unless a future explicit canonical identity-merger contract exists.
